title: Michael Bridgford
intro:
Michael Bridgford (independent) is running for election to the U.S. House to represent Iowa's 1st Congressional District. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Bridgford completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
